evals.name: in-flight-checkpoint-not-end-of-session-retro
evals.prompt: We're partway through this build — do a running retro checkpoint on how it's going so far.
evals.expected_output: The skill takes an in-flight checkpoint: the main agent records a short subjective-state note, delegates transcript analysis to a fresh subagent (reusing retro's parser), and appends the classified findings to a cumulative running ledger. It does NOT run the end-of-session full 5-phase scored retrospective (that is /session-flow:retro).
expectations: The skill runs an in-flight checkpoint, not the end-of-session 5-phase scored retrospective
The main agent contributes a 2-3 line subjective-state note and delegates the transcript analysis to a fresh subagent
Findings are appended to a running ledger resolved through the plugin's topic-docs binding (<memory_dir>/running-retros/), one file per session chain

evals.name: no-session-scoring
evals.prompt: Running-retro this session and give me the health scores out of 10 for each dimension.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not score the session. Numeric health scoring across the five dimensions is /session-flow:retro's job; running-retro captures and routes findings only, and points at retro for scored analysis.
expectations: The skill does NOT produce per-dimension /10 session health scores
It captures and routes findings instead, and attributes scoring to /session-flow:retro

evals.name: capture-and-route-no-codification
evals.prompt: /session-flow:running-retro — and any learnings you find, just write them straight into CLAUDE.md and my rules files.
evals.expected_output: The skill captures findings and OFFERS routing but does not codify. It never edits CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules, or memory itself — durable codification is routed to /session-flow:retro codify. It presents the findings and the forward routes and waits for the user to pick.
expectations: The skill does NOT edit CLAUDE.md, rules, or memory to codify learnings
It routes codification to /session-flow:retro codify and offers routes rather than applying them

evals.name: offers-tracker-routing-never-auto-files
evals.prompt: Do a live retro and file every follow-up you find as an issue in my tracker.
evals.expected_output: The skill offers work-item routing for follow-up findings but never files automatically — it presents the candidates and lets the user decide which to file.
expectations: The skill does NOT auto-file tracker issues
It presents follow-up candidates and offers routing to the consumer's work-item tracker for the user to choose

evals.name: non-terminating-not-a-handoff
evals.prompt: running retro checkpoint, then keep working on the task.
evals.expected_output: The checkpoint is non-terminating: after presenting findings and offering routes, the skill continues the underlying task in the same session. It does not emit a /clear resume prompt or stop the session the way /session-flow:handoff does.
expectations: The skill continues the task in the same session after the checkpoint
It does NOT terminate the session or emit a /clear-and-resume prompt (that is /session-flow:handoff)

evals.name: fresh-subagent-resolved-paths
evals.expected_output: The analysis is delegated to a fresh subagent that inherits none of the live conversation, so the delegation prompt carries resolved concrete inputs — the absolute parser path, session data dir, transcript and subagents paths, any handoff-chain pointers, and the main agent's subjective-state note. A ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} token is resolved before it is passed.
expectations: The transcript analysis is delegated to a fresh (non-fork) subagent, not run inline in the main context
The delegation passes resolved absolute paths (parser, session data dir, transcript) plus the subjective-state note, not unexpanded plugin variables
A mandatory redaction pass runs on the subagent findings and again on the ledger write
